function: Multi-encoder VAE recovers and enhances cross-modal visual and audio information
note: Here MIMO names a VAE with two encoders and two decoders for audio-visual data recovery, not a multi-antenna link, so the task falls outside the seven areas.

function: DRL learns ground-node service scheduling for RIS-assisted fixed-wing UAV coverage
note: The DRL handles service scheduling over a hybrid action space in an RIS-assisted aerial link, with trajectories from a non-learned convex-hull algorithm, and the abstract does not say whether its actions include time slots or RIS phases, which would count as physical layer, or only user scheduling above it.

function: Federated DRL decides collaborative computation offloading in multi-UAV-assisted IoV
note: Learning is applied only to the offloading strategy, while transmit power and computing resources are allocated by convex optimization through the KKT conditions.

function: VAE-CNN denoises and extracts RSS features for RIS-aided indoor localization
note: The generative model serves RSS-based indoor localization, a function outside the seven areas.

function: Spatiotemporal fusion neural network predicts LEO satellite IoT traffic
note: The learned method predicts traffic, which lies above the physical layer and is not the learned power, resource, or beam control that the satellite exception covers.

function: Improved SAC jointly manages energy and resources in UAV-assisted SWIPT-MEC
note: The SAC balances UAV energy, terminal charging through SWIPT, and computing resources over a hybrid action space, and the abstract does not say whether it controls the UAV's transmit power or time allocation, which the aerial exception counts as physical layer, or only trajectory and edge-computing decisions.

function: Trust-aware DRL selects sensing cells and workers in sparse crowdsensing
note: Despite the ISAC label, the DRL selects crowdsensing cells and workers and matrix factorization infers missing data, which are application-level task decisions with no beam, waveform, or radio-resource design.

function: Low-complexity delay-Doppler channel estimation for Zak-transform OTFS, without learning
note: The estimator is model-based (decoupled channel representation, matched-filter bin levels, phase de-rotation), and sparse Bayesian learning appears only as a baseline.

function: Semantic neural networks trained end to end over RIS-optimized channels
note: The precoder and RIS phase shifts are optimized first without learning, and the learned semantic codec performs none of the seven functions.

function: Conditional GAN reconstructs scenes in SIM-aided multimodal semantic communication
note: The SIM is configured by a gradient-descent optimization rather than learning, and the learned conditional GAN only reconstructs the scene from semantic information, which is not one of the seven functions.

function: Surveys OTFS modulation, its MIMO, multiple-access, satellite, and ISAC uses
note: The paper is a comprehensive survey of OTFS rather than a proposed and evaluated method.

function: Gradient-descent SIM phase optimization for RSSI-based indoor positioning
note: SIM phases are set by gradient descent and alternating optimization, with the DNN mentioned only as an analogy, and the task is indoor positioning, which is outside the seven areas anyway.

function: Transformer estimates user coordinates from CSI, RSS, geometry, and RIS phases
note: The learned model performs indoor localization, a function outside the seven areas, and the RIS phase strategy is not described as learned.

function: Surveys generative AI combined with digital twins for 6G networks
note: The paper surveys GenAI-enabled digital twins and outlines challenges and directions rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Surveys AI-driven energy-efficient UAV-assisted 6G communications and roadmap
note: The paper is a survey and research roadmap that synthesizes more than 200 works rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Reviews the waste-factor energy-inefficiency metric for backscatter communications
note: The paper is a self-described review of the foundations, potential, and challenges of the waste-factor metric, and it proposes no learned method.

function: Systematizes pilot-efficient RIS channel estimation literature into estimator families
note: The article organizes the RIS channel estimation literature into pilot-based, semi-blind, and learning-based families and distills guidelines, a systematization of the field rather than a new method.

function: Adversarial perturbations obfuscate intercepted CSI against eavesdropper activity recognition
note: The method perturbs the transmitted signal to defeat an eavesdropper's CSI-based human activity recognition, a physical-layer privacy function outside the seven areas.

function: Surveys AI for wireless physical-layer modules and 3GPP standardization
note: The paper is a comprehensive survey of AI for the physical layer rather than a proposed and evaluated method.

function: Two-timescale PPO adapts network slicing, UAV trajectory, and resource allocation
note: Slicing and trajectory lie above the physical layer, but the PPO also learns slice-level resource allocation in a UAV network, and the abstract does not say whether this covers link bandwidth, which the aerial exception counts as physical layer.

function: Generates Zak-OTFS signals through time and frequency windowing filters
note: The paper designs twisted-convolution filters realized by windowing for Zak-OTFS transmission, with no learned component.

function: RL selects the UAV's region-visiting trajectory for IoT computation offloading
note: Learning is used only for UAV trajectory design, and the energy procurement cost is handled by a separately formulated minimization problem.

function: Multi-agent RL controls pursuer UAV mobility and power to jam drones
note: The learned mobility and power control serves counter-drone jamming, not the control of a communication link in any of the seven areas.

function: Sparse Bayesian DOA and range estimation for FDA-MIMO radar jamming suppression
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is an iterative sparse-recovery algorithm rather than a model trained on data, and the system is a radar rather than a communication link.

function: DRL allocates UAV resources for AoI-aware IoT data collection in crowdsourcing
note: The abstract stresses UAV mobility constraints, which lie above the physical layer, but it does not say which resources the DRL allocates, so learned power, bandwidth, or time-slot control of the aerial link, which the aerial exception counts as physical layer, cannot be ruled out.

function: Dropout-based parametric BiG-AMP for joint channel and data estimation
note: The equalizer is an iterative message-passing algorithm in which dropout means random partial updates and EM estimates channel prior parameters, with no model trained on data.

function: Message passing and SBL for grant-free activity detection and channel estimation
note: Both stages are model-based Bayesian algorithms (enhanced message passing and sparse Bayesian learning) with no model trained on data.

function: Adversarial learning extracts common channel features for secret key generation
note: The learned method serves physical-layer secret key generation against a malicious RIS, a security function outside the seven areas.

function: DRL selects UAV hovering positions for AoI-guaranteed IoT data collection
note: The DRL decides only UAV hovering positions, while STAR-RIS beamforming and device scheduling are solved by SDR-based optimization without learning.

function: Majorization-minimization beamforming for RIS-assisted multi-cell over-the-air computation
note: Beamforming and RIS design use majorization-minimization and successive alignment for generic data aggregation, with no learned component and no federated learning model.

function: Statistics-based JSCC scheme for compressed downlink CSI feedback in massive MIMO
note: The feedback scheme relies on distortion-rate theory and channel second-order statistics, and deep learning appears only as a baseline.
